messages:
status-bot: ALERT: Partial customer impact in hosted inference (us-east-2) starting ~14:03 UTC. Symptoms: sudden increase in 502/504 for low-latency routes and connection resets for websocket sessions. Impact concentrated on short-generation traffic (<512 tokens). Live incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2798765432 :rotating_light:

leo: seeing upstream weight drop to 0 for several ingress backends after the recent edge config rollout. healthchecks show 503s from runtime-svc when probed via the new probe path. Suspect config mismatch in the healthprobe route.

maya: confirmed: a recent ingress template change swapped the liveness probe path for the low-latency pool. Probing path returned 404 causing LB to mark hosts unhealthy. Rolling back the ingress template now.

infra: rollback command issued: `infractl apply -f ingress-template-prev.yaml --region us-east-2 --component edge-proxy`

ops: mitigation applied:
- rolled back ingress template on canary and started staggered rollout rollback to region
- temporarily routed low-latency traffic to a warm fallback pool (model-variants: small-latency) to prevent customer-facing 5xxs
- increased edge-proxy connection pool by +30% to reduce tail resets
- activated per-tenant short-request queuing to smooth spikes

leo: graphs: p50 stable, p95/p99 and 502 spikes on low-latency routes dropped after canary rollback. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/edge/ingress-health?from=now-30m&to=now

maya: rolling rollback to 100% now. Expected completion ~6m. Also adding a preflight check to validate probe path returns 200 for all pools.

support: drafting customer broadcast for affected tenants (primarily hosted low-latency customers). Draft note: "We experienced intermittent request failures and connection resets in us-east-2 due to an edge configuration change. We rolled back the change and applied a fallback routing policy. You may see improved stability; contact support if you continue to see errors." Will send once we confirm 10m stability.

oncall: collecting affected request IDs and traces. Please tag any enterprise accounts that reported incidents. I'll attach traces to the incident artifacts.

infra: artifacts archived: s3://incidents/2798765432/artifacts (ingress diffs, healthcheck logs, edge-proxy metrics). Please avoid recycling canary hosts until capture complete.

leo: observed immediate drop in 502s on rolled-back hosts. fallback pool absorbing remaining short-gen traffic; no data loss or model state exposure. Expanding rollback complete.

ops: next steps:
- add ingress preflight that validates probe paths across all pools before rollout (OPS-9001)
- add automatic rollback trigger when backend healthy <= 90% over 2m after config apply
- run a targeted chaos test for probe-path misconfigurations in staging
- customer outreach: send broadcast + 1:1 for flagged enterprise tenants

maya: post-incident ticket created: ENG-12045 (ingress probe preflight + rollout guard).

support: standing by for replies on the broadcast channel. Flagging priority customers for direct outreach.

status-bot: Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2798765432 (live updates and runbook). Broadcast scheduled in 8m if metrics remain stable.

leo: closing update: rollback complete, p99/p95 returned to baseline. We'll keep the incident open for 30m of stability and then send a final customer summary. If you see recurrence, please tag `@oncall` and attach traces to the incident artifacts. :white_check_mark:
